jobs.details: Front-End Developer Front-End Developer Digistore24/Eklektika Rad od kuće online intervju 04.10.2026. Oglas dostupan i osobama sa invaliditetom JavaScript CSS HTML CMS QA intermediate Front-End Developer – Marketing team REMOTE / FULL-TIME Are you a hands-on developer who values fast, accessible, meticulously built websites and is comfortable working within an established technical and design system? Do you want to build and maintain high-performing marketing pages using a framework-light architecture while avoiding unnecessary reinvention? If yes, then this could be your next favorite role. We’re looking for a Front-End Developer to join our remote team and help implement and evolve our marketing website. Who is Digistore24? Here at Digistore24, we create client success. Our mission is to empower limitless success for digital entrepreneurs through innovation, connection, and growth, helping them reach their audiences by automating and digitalizing the complete sales process: from order forms, invoices, affiliates, payment processes, and statistics to accounting and conversion optimization. Eklektika, a company from Belgrade, has existed for 20 years and recently became an integral part of the German/USA company Digistore24. Digistore24 is a global affiliate marketplace connecting offer owners and affiliates across digital products, subscriptions, services, and online business models, operating in ecosystems where visibility, trust, and speed matter. Your Mission: This is not your average developer role. In fact, this is not a React, Vue, Tailwind, or Bootstrap role. Our marketing site is intentionally framework-light, relying on Astro for fully static output, Sanity as a headless CMS for structured content and translations, and vanilla JavaScript and CSS for front-end behavior and styling. Your mission is to ensure our marketing website communicates our ambition through a clear, high-performing, and consistent digital experience. You’ll initially focus on content development within Sanity Studio, using existing Custom Code components and our established ds24-prefixed architecture. As your familiarity with the platform grows, you will expand into translating approved designs into reusable, production-ready Astro sections, templates, and page components. Success in this position depends less on familiarity with a specific framework and more on strong fundamentals, sound engineering judgment, and the discipline to extend existing conventions rather than creating competing patterns. Responsibilities: Implementing and maintaining marketing pages using existing Sanity page-builder sections, content models, and Custom Code components. Building responsive interfaces with semantic HTML, modern vanilla CSS, and purposeful vanilla JavaScript, keeping performance and maintainability central to every implementation. Gradually expanding into writing GROQ queries to retrieve the content required by pages and components. Applying the established Digistore24 design system and section structure consistently, improving existing patterns only through appropriate architectural and review processes. Validating work thoroughly across breakpoints and supported browsers to identify and resolve visual, responsive, accessibility, and functional issues before release. Working closely with design, marketing, content, and engineering stakeholders to incorporate feedback efficiently and communicate constraints, trade-offs, and implementation status clearly. Using AI
